spatial_discretization.method: three-grid GCI with nominal refinement ratio 2 and safety factor 1.25

cl.convergence: monotone over the finest three grids

spatial_discretization.interpretation: Conditional three-grid GCI estimates using nominal r=2; monotonicity alone does not establish the asymptotic range. The underlying study explicitly does not establish an asymptotic order.

experimental_uncertainty.consequence: Partial instrument and repeatability evidence is recorded separately. No complete measurement budget or combined numerical-plus-experimental validation interval is claimed.

primary_report.interpretation: Instrument accuracy and repeat-point differences are not standard uncertainties at alpha=10.10 deg. The report does not assign them a probability distribution or coverage factor; CN is not CL.
